culturalBackground: Modern mehndi mixes traditional motifs with open space, geometric lines and contemporary elements.
Indo-Arabic fusion, which combines fine Indian detail with bold Arabic flow, is one of the most common modern styles.
Some modern designs borrow from tattoo art, with single motifs placed on the wrist, fingers or forearm.
White henna and glitter are cosmetic body paints, not real henna, and they do not stain the skin.
applicationTips: Plan where the bare skin will be before you start; in modern designs the empty space is part of the pattern.
Mix line weights, using bold outlines with fine detail inside.
Keep the two hands related but not identical for a contemporary look.
